Hello Wllian,
Thank you so much for these 5 stars.
Our team will be delighted.

Kind regards
Village Vets Coolock

Hello Elaine,
Thank you so much for these 5 stars.
We really appreciate them.

Kind regards
Village Vets Coolock

I had a brilliant experience at village vets Coolock. I was in with my cat Napoleon for his vaccines and a general health check with their vet Ricardo. Ricardo was thorough, professional, and reassuring, taking the time to explain everything clearly and making sure Napoleon was comfortable throughout the visit. A special mention also goes to the receptionist Darina, who was friendly, welcoming, and very helpful from the moment we arrived. It made the whole experience feel easy and stress-free. I would happily recommend this practice and Ricardo to other pet owners.
Thank you so much for your 5-star review!
Thank you very much for your kind review. Feedback like this means a lot to our staff and we appreciate it so much. We hope to see you and your pet soon! Village Vets Coolock
Village vets Coolock, the staff there are absolutely amazing. 5 stars can say no more.
Excellent attention to our cats. Very satisfied. We left another practice to go to Coolock vets and we have no regrets.

This vet has the worst policy in regard to appointments!!! Best is to avoid... If you are running a few minutes late they'll refuse to take you in!! And when you arrive  there and have to wait 15+ or sometimes over 30min that's ok.... My dog was in bad condition due to a skin infection and they don't have the humanity of even seeing him for some lousy 5 minutes. So if you get stuck in traffic and are just a little bit late, just know that they don't care about your dog's wellbeing and will refuse, so thank you Village Vets Coolock for this amazing service and flexibility, and just take a minute  to think that if it's a person with disabilities that couldn't arrive on that specific time how would you feel for them and their dog! Also a big shout out to the girls at reception that are as helpful as an AI assistant 👏🏻  absolutely zero empathy and humanity in them.
excellent and efficient service as always

🎀⭐️FabulousZ
ServiceZ&TreatmentZ
ThankyouZ HoneZ⭐️🎀 …
They were so kind to my new pup and i plan on making Village Vets in Coolock my regular vet as a result!
Thank you so much for your five-star review!

I had to get an eye test for my dog recently and my vet was not able to do this so when I asked village vets can they help I got an appointment with them and thankfully they were amazing so helpful and friendly made me and my dog feel safe and gave him the tests he needed and he is doing very well I am so grateful to them and would highly recommend them to family and friends thanks again for your help
Kind regards
Margaret

I was in the Coolock branch and Alan was there for my Ruby’s consultation for her librella injection, Alan is one of the longest nurses in the practice and I’m always delighted when he’s there for my appointment. He’s so kind and caring and goes above and beyond for us every time, I wish he was there all the time . He just makes our visit so much easier because he knows Ruby’s history by heart and knows her temperament and treats her accordingly. So a big thanks to Alan.
The staff at Village Vets are wonderful. They are very professional, kind and helpful.
Great team, attentive and helpful! The vet was very kind. I recommend them.

Hello Vanessa,
Thank you very much for your 4 star review.
Great vets
Great service and friendly caring staff
Once again the team is amazing! Got an appointment for Penny very quick. Keep up the good work!
I have always found all the staff to be very friendly helpful and professional . They are kind and caring and I would definitely recommend them.
Excellent, staff very friendly and informative, Scarlet is a happy bunny with his nails clipped, Thank you
Vets and staff that looked after Kevin were fantastic!!! Always fantastic !!!

Village Vets are unbelievable. They advised us to visit Ashbourne after hours care with our GR puppy and they took great care with him, advised us and sent us home with everything we needed. Coolock then followed up with daily calls and texts to check in on him which is just so so lovely. I spoke with Christine I think, and honestly she's so caring and lovely. Thanks for everything, Toby bounced back super quick from his little viral infection.

Our buddy loves going around to village vets, the staff are like family to us all. The warm welcome and smiles are so much appreciated. Visits are so enjoyable. Thank you to all the staff, you are amazing 🤩 …
Thank you very much for your kind review. Feedback like this means a lot to our staff and we appreciate it so much. We hope to see you and your pet soon! All the team in Village Vets Coolock!
Very satisfied with the care Dougie gets ..

Had the two dogs at Village Vets Coolock and enjoyed excellent service. The desk staff were very welcoming and so enthusiastic about the dogs. The vet saw them immediately and was very knowledgeable and professional and thorough. Couldn’t ask for anymore. Exceptional service

My Red Setterr Jagger is very very nervous going to the vets and Carla in Village Vets Lusk has gone out of her way to try to overcome this.This week Jagger had a lump on his nose and needed a surgical procedure.Jagger did not want to go into vets but Peter and staff coaxed him in and surgery went ahead.I cannot thank all the staff enough for caring for Jagger.

Hello Viktorija,
Thank you for taking the time to review our page and leave us these 5 stars.
We really appreciate them.

Kind regards
Village Vets Coolock

Absolutely wonderful veterinary practice. The whole team showed such kindness, professionalism, and genuine care for my dog. They took the time to explain everything and made me feel completely at ease. I’m so grateful for the excellent care we received and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them. Thank you for taking such great care of my dog ❤️

I have been coming here for almost 5 years. This was my best visit with my lab. We saw Alan, a lovely nurse who took the time to chat with us and explain everything to help her. I would love to see him everytime I go. First enjoyable visit. Thank you Alan.
So so amazing thank you

We got a dog for my daughter who is special needs a beautiful little girl a Russian Chihuahua to be a support dog so when it came to getting her spayed it was important for my daughter to come to the consultation as she had a lot of questions to ask..the vet put her and my mind at ease and my daughter was happy for her baby to get the procedure done..this was a big deal for my daughter but the vet was so reassuring and we booked..on the day the vet again spike with us and put our mind at ease..we then collected lolly in the morning she was so well taken care of and staff gave her lots of cuddles..she is doing great and healed brilliantly i highly recommend village vets they are so caring and reassuring and great prices

Thank you so much for taking the time to review our page and leave us these 5 stars. We really appreciate them.

Kind regards
Village Vets Coolock

Hello Ita,
Thank you very much for taking the time to review our page and leave us these 5 stars. We really appreciate them.

Kind regards
Village Vets Coolock
I have my 3 puppers on the pet plan in the coolock branch, and all the staff are amazing and so caring and kind to each of their personalities and to me as an owner too, I can't praise them enough
Excellent service for our cat Rocky. Great availability of appointments and very professional staff. Would highly recommend.

My poor cat was largely unresponsive this morning, couldn't walk or eat, so in fairness I rang them and I brought my cat in. They were unable to get an IV into him, then I was hit with the cost of bloods and a few other tests coming in at 500 euro, but that would just be the start. As my cat was so sick it would likely warrant hospital stays and further testing. I told the vet I simply can't afford it. I made the difficult decision to euthanize the cat. It cost €222 they were not able to do it through IV, only into the heart! I was prevented from watching the procedure as it's not pleasant when ordinarily you would be able to see him pass on through IV. While waiting I rang another clinic that quoted €150 for the procedure I'd have gone there only my cat was so sick. I found it very costly and that didn't include any ashes or other memories. Not a pleasant experience overall. I think the cost was far too high considering the experience.

Hello Emma,
We are very sorry to see that you have given us a one star review. We would love to know more on the reasoning behind this review. Can you please email us directly at coolock@villagevets.ie so we can resolve this.

Kind regards
Village Vets Coolock

This is a brilliant facility, conveniently located in the community.  The staff are very friendly and Harry in particular gave great care to Alby our 15year old dog.

We have being using Village Vets for quite some time now and I would highly recommend for any pet owners.
I have used a few different vets over the years and I found Village the best for value and efficiency . Pet plan is a must.  Very helpful

Such a relief to be able to get an emergency appointment for Paddy, my little Cavachon! The vet was thorough and very kind and Village Vets had all the medication that he needs in stock. Paddy has taken some food today and it looks as if he’s turned a corner. Thank you Village Vets!
Always very attentive to my pets needs & provide the best aid toward my dog. Although I rang same day they were able to fit me in which is a great peace of mind

Hello Tatjana,
Thank you for taking the time to review our page and leaving us these 5 stars.
We really appreciate it.
Kind regards
Village Vets Coolock
The staff are all very friendly and helpful. My cat was well cared for by Vet Theo.

I had a very disappointing experience with the staff at this clinic. When I called to ask about my dog’s pregnancy, I was never put on hold, yet I could clearly hear the staff in the background laughing, making comments about the situation, and even questioning whether we were “really their customer.”

When the staff member returned to the phone, I informed her that the line had not been muted and that I heard their entire conversation. Instead of apologizing or showing any concern, she offered no acknowledgment of how unprofessional and disrespectful the situation was.

This experience left me feeling completely dismissed and uncomfortable. I expect basic professionalism and courtesy from a veterinary office, and unfortunately, that was not what I received.

Tbag is 13 years old, looks and behaves like a puppy full of life and good health. This is all due to the tender care of the wonderful staff at the village Vets in Coolock. It amazes me that they all know her as soon as they see her. They love to see her ❤️

I had an emergency case with my dog on Friday. I called this practice to ask for help as my own Vet was closed. My dog had collapsed out of nowhere was sick and was drooling.
It was about 6.45pm and they are supposed to be open until 8pm. I was told they were fully booked and that I should go to MEATH. I live local to Coolock.
Luckily I emailed my own Vet after this on the off chance that he was still at the practice and he rang me back.
Sadly they found a tumor and he had to be put to sleep.
The village vets in Coolock were so lacking in empathy. There should ALWAYS be room for an emergency case if you care about animals. Your practice is a disgrace.
Great staff, very friendly, knowledgeable with any questions or concerns we have. Always look after our cats with the best care.

Harry , the vet i was dealing with was absolutely brilliant 👏  He listened to all my concerns about my cat Philly and gave me some great advice.  The staff on reception were also lovely.  It makes all the difference when you're stressed out over your pet. …
Always a lovely experience here. Staff very helpful and friendly   we bring our rabbit there and you can see the staff have a genuine love of animals. Highly recommend
Excellent care and very helpful staff.

Excellent care from start to finish , the most friendly professional staff, who explained everything regarding the procedure , all fees were outlined and explained before I booked the procedure and no question I had was a bother to them  . Skye was relaxed and not stressed at all , they cared for her as if she was one of their own. Absolutely wonderful Vet family. Would highly recommend.

We went for a worming treatment and sign off the passport for our 2 dogs.

They charged us €148 for that. A complete absurd to charge this amount of money for less than 15min of consultation for both of the dogs.

And the vet was also very pushy for dental treatment and wanted to do an x-ray for a dead tooth my older dog has for 8 years, has been examinated for other vet and is not bothering her.
He just didn’t bother hearing what I was saying about how I manage our dog’s health, absolute zero attention to us.

I just went to them because my regular vet was not available and the treatment was time sensitive for my upcoming trip.
Very professional, fast service- in and out in 2omin great medical advice for the dog, dog was right again a week after treatment 👍 recommended to all. …
Thank you so much.
We just moved from the U.K. and Lucy and the team at Coolock have been absolutely amazing taking care of Big P. We have the Pet Health Plan which is excellent value for money.

Village Vets Coolock are a fabuloud vet clinic. They're very skilled and friendly, and very approachable to ask questions to about different aspects of pet care. They're also very good with handling dogs that are nervous in vets. Lucy was an absolute delight to see, and she was really good with our two dogs!
Thanks so much Lynn and for this lovely picture too.
Kind friendly and gentle staff
Brought our dog Mack here on his last day. We rang that morning and they were able to get us in the afternoon. They made saying goodbye so peaceful for us, we really appreciate it

I really like the Coolock/Malahide Rd. Branch - everyone is always eager to assist and are helpful. I have 4 animals and on many occasions I've been into the clinic and they know them by name straight away - the vets are knowledgeable, empathetic and give us the time we need for each animal. I would recommend them to a friend or family.
Thank you very much Anthony
Thank you very much.
Excellent reception on arrival. Vet care was soooo kind and gentle. Coco was so at ease with her even when giving her needle. No problem recommending this clinic
Excellent care. I was even called on a bank holiday monday from the vets personal phone to check on my dog's condition. Highly recommend the Village Vets.

Thank you so much for the lovely care Gismo received
Hes doing great. Also my mind was put at ease
Love from Gismo and Deirdre

All the staff are always pleasant and helpful. Highly recommended. The health plan has been a godsend for us as Ellie has a skin condition and is on regular meds. As this is our first experience of a cat, and a pretty sick and extremely anxious  little girl when we first found her, the staff have been amazing answering any and all questions and reassuring us that we are doing great. Always happy to board Ellie with them as I know they look after her so well.
Wonderful people. Excellent approach to pet care. I am very pleased with their work.
I found Val very informative and had all the information that I needed. My dog was relaxed and didn't get stressed like she had at other vets.
Thank you so much John.

My older Doberman has been a patient of Village Vets in Coolick for 3 years. He has had many visits and I find the staff to be friendly and helpful, always. I also avail of their yearly plan, which gives me free visits.
Veterinary care here is excellent and every effort is made to keep my dog in good health. I’d highly recommend the vets and staff here.
UPDATE: one year later,
My beautiful friend had to be euthanised this past week. The staff were so kind and had my boy on the floor on a blanket so my son sat down with him. It was a dignified end to his life and I have to give credit to the staff, they are the best.
I have always find a good support here.
Thank you for the 5-star review, Vladimir!
Every member of staff was so nice and attentive to Riley. Very welcoming and comfortable experience. Can’t recommend this vet enough!

Very happy with this vet , my Cat went for his first visit there yesterday and it was calm experience, lovely waiting area & reception
Very friendly
Staff are so kind and patient, my pup loves the vet for this reason!
Very nice and helpful

We just picked up a kitten who had obvious issues with his eyes and anyway needed to start a healthy life plan. We walked into this clinic and never regretted. Good care, great advice, and a reasonable healthcare plan! Highly recommended.
I have been bringing my dog milo to village vets coolock for 7 years I wouldn't trust any other vets can't vault them
Thank you very much for your kind review.

Honest review!
Any experience that both myself & my husband have had to date with VILLAGE VETS Coolock has been a positive one. Our 2 dogs have no fear visiting any of the Village Vets practices & are both happy 2 go with any of the vets paticularly Val in Coolock who has dealt with us from the very beginning with our GSD who has had a few health concerns over the last 3 yrs & our 11 yr old Beagle. Val has always been very kind & caring 👏🏻 & our 2 dogs needs are always met & they always come 1st. The staff on reception are also welcoming & pleasant. The environment is calm. Any concerns we have had with any of the vets we have seen are fully investigated until resolved & plans are put in place there & then with follow up checks arranged. Nothing is an issue. The vets are all caring & kind to all the animals & have the interest in each animals individually needs & go above & beyond 2 explain & offer all treatment options that are available. We always come away feeling confident that our 2 dogs are in safe & very capable hands. We would highly recommend VILLAGE VETS COOLOCK
I brought my dog to Village Vets in Coolock. Lovely friendly service and the issue was resolved. Would highly recommend.

The staff and Vets are fantastic The service is second to none and all very friendly and explain everything to you. I have had dog for the last 40 years and this Village Vets are 200% care about your dog.
Been bringing my dog tucker here a while now & the staff & care he gets are always 100%!! Super friendly, professional and approachable wouldn't go anywhere else 😊 …
Friendly staff that make you and your pet feel relaxed.  Vet takes time to explain everything
Thank you very much.
excellent staff.great service. friendly staff very helpful

I went there with my dog that had a BOAR surgery and started panting on the way to the vet. I called and told that I would be 5 to 10min late. When I got there they wouldn’t see my dog even there was no one waiting! I stayed there until 8pm and they didn’t want to see my dog. Kevin, the receptionist was the worse ever, rude and yelled me to go home. Worst experience ever. STAY AWAY FROM VILLAGE VETS COOLOK. They lack humanity! They lack what is needed to be a good vet: ethics and love for the animals.
